name: BanglaSenTri: A Three-Class Bangla Text–Speech Sentiment Dataset
description: BanglaSenTri is a three-class Bangla text–speech sentiment dataset designed to support research in speech sentiment analysis, multimodal learning, and natural language processing for low-resource languages. It contains 2,100 Bangla text samples and 6,300 corresponding audio recordings, covering positive, negative, and neutral sentiment.
